summary.intent: Run /gsd-update --reapply to merge local GSD customizations back after updating from v1.4.3 to v1.6.0. After finding no real edits, pivot to removing the committed local GSD install (with hardcoded absolute paths) from the repo entirely.
summary.outcome: Confirmed all 318 'modified' backup files were false positives (install-time path substitution drift, not hand-edits). Cleaned up stale backup dirs, untracked 453 GSD-managed files from git, added gitignore coverage for old and new GSD layouts, and committed the cleanup to a chore branch.

repo: Local GSD install was committed to the repo with 119+ files containing hardcoded absolute paths (e.g. /Users/myankelev/Code/random/cipher-box/.claude/), breaking the install for any other contributor
GSD v1.6.0 changed the command layout: commands moved from commands/gsd/<name>.md (directory per command) to flat commands/gsd-<name>.md files at .claude/ root
gsd-pristine/ was accidentally tracked in git — it's an update-scratch directory that should never be committed
92 .planning/ milestone files contain hardcoded absolute GSD paths baked in by the planner at plan-generation time
The reapply workflow's false-positive rate was 100% here: the recorded pristine_hashes are post-substitution hashes, so the npm→install transform appears as 'user changes' to the verifier

code.finding: computePathPrefix function: global installs emit portable $HOME/... tokens; local installs emit absolute paths. This is intentional — @-includes and Read paths must resolve regardless of CWD. No relative-path mode exists.

workflow: To distinguish real user edits from installer drift: compare backup files against committed git HEAD (byte-level diff), check git log for non-install commits on GSD files, and diff against raw npm tarball — three independent signals
git rm --cached removes files from index without deleting them from disk; safe for untracking while preserving working-tree state
The GSD file manifest (gsd-file-manifest.json) stores SHA hashes rather than paths, so you cannot enumerate managed file paths from it directly

friction: Had staged 453 deletions directly on main before noticing branch-protection; had to create chore/untrack-local-gsd-install branch after the fact (changes carry over automatically)

ls reported commands/gsd/ as MISSING after git rm --cached, causing momentary concern — the directory was actually already deleted by the 1.6.0 update (D status in pre-session git status), not by the untrack operation
GSD's verifier reported 153 failures + 143 no_baseline as alarming-looking errors, but all were the same install-drift false positives — the signal was noisy
gsd-pristine/ had mixed tracked/untracked content, requiring both git rm and a separate rm -rf to fully remove
open_items: 92 .planning/ milestone files contain hardcoded /Users/myankelev/Code/random/cipher-box/.claude/ paths — not addressed, intentionally deferred
8 unrelated 1.6.0 tracked-file modifications remain unstaged/uncommitted (kept out of the focused untracking commit)
chore/untrack-local-gsd-install branch needs to be pushed and PR'd
No README or script documents how contributors should regenerate the local GSD install (npx @opengsd/gsd-core@<version> --claude --local) now that it's untracked; pinned version guidance is missing
